function.name: add_device
function.description: This function adds a device by querying the registry value, initializing object attributes, opening the device file, and controlling the device IO. It handles different types of devices such as HID, mouse, and keyboard. If the device is already added or any operation fails, it returns NULL. Otherwise, it returns the added device.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Handle to an open registry key

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of the device to be added

function.return_type: struct device, represents the added device if successful, otherwise NULL

function.name: enumerate_devices
function.description: This function enumerates devices of a specific type and class. It opens the registry key for the class, then iterates over each device key in the class. For each device, it opens the interface key and adds the device.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: This parameter represents the type of the device to be enumerated.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: This parameter represents the class of the device to be enumerated.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value. It performs actions based on the parameters given.

function.name: rawinput_update_device_list
function.description: This function updates the list of raw input devices. It removes all devices from the list, closes their files, and frees their memory. Then it enumerates new devices of type mouse, keyboard, and HID.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: This parameter is used to force the update of the device list regardless of the time elapsed since the last check.

function.return_type: void, meaning this function does not return any value

function.name: find_device_from_handle
function.description: This function searches for a device in the devices list using the provided handle. If the device is not found and refresh is true, it updates the device list and searches again.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: The handle of the device to search for.

parameters.name: refresh
parameters.description: A flag indicating whether to refresh the device list if the device is not initially found.

function.return_type: struct device, represents the device found with the given handle. If no device is found, it returns NULL.

function.name: NtUserGetRawInputDeviceList
function.description: This function retrieves the raw input device list, updates the device list, and returns the count of the devices.

parameters.name: device_list
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of RAWINPUTDEVICELIST structures to receive the information about raw input devices

parameters.name: device_count
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that specifies the number of RAWINPUTDEVICELIST structures requested

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of a single RAWINPUTDEVICELIST structure

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of devices in the list. If the function fails, it returns ~0u.

function.name: NtUserGetRawInputDeviceInfo
function.description: This function retrieves information about the raw input device.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: A handle to the raw input device.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The command to issue for the raw input device.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: A pointer to the data that comes from the raw input device.

parameters.name: data_size
parameters.description: A pointer to the size of the data from the raw input device.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the size of the data from the raw input device or an error code.

function.name: NtUserGetRawInputBuffer
function.description: This function retrieves the raw input from a device.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the raw input data.

parameters.name: data_size
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that specifies the size, in bytes, of the data in the buffer specified by the pData parameter.

parameters.name: header_size
parameters.description: Size of the header for the raw input data.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of raw input data. If the function fails, the return value is (UINT)-1.

function.name: NtUserGetRawInputData
function.description: This function retrieves raw input data from a specified device.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: A handle to the raw input device.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The command to issue for the raw input data.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: A pointer to the data that comes from the raw input device.

parameters.name: data_size
parameters.description: A pointer to the size of the data in bytes.

parameters.name: header_size
parameters.description: The size of the header for the raw input data.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of bytes that are copied into data, or -1 if there is an error.

function.name: process_rawinput_message
function.description: This function processes raw input messages, handles device changes, and updates the thread's raw input data.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Pointer to the message to be processed.

parameters.name: hw_id
parameters.description: Hardware ID associated with the message.

parameters.name: msg_data
parameters.description: Pointer to the data of the hardware message.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function executes successfully, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: post_device_notifications
function.description: This function posts device notifications for different types of devices such as mouse, keyboard and HID. It iterates over a list of devices and posts a message for each device that matches the usage page and usage of the filter.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to a RAWINPUTDEVICE structure that specifies the device for which notifications are to be posted.

function.return_type: void, meaning it does not return any value

function.name: register_rawinput_device
function.description: This function registers a raw input device and updates the registered device count. It also handles device removal and device notifications.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the raw input device to be registered or removed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value

function.name: NtUserRegisterRawInputDevices
function.description: This function registers raw input devices for the calling thread or removes previously registered raw input devices from the calling thread.

parameters.name: devices
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of RAWINPUTDEVICE structures that represent the devices to be registered.

parameters.name: device_count
parameters.description: Number of RAWINPUTDEVICE structures pointed to by the devices parameter.

parameters.name: device_size
parameters.description: Size of the RAWINPUTDEVICE structure.

function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the function is successful. Otherwise, it returns FALSE.

function.name: NtUserGetRegisteredRawInputDevices
function.description: This function retrieves the registered raw input devices for the current application.

parameters.name: devices
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of RAWINPUTDEVICE structures that will receive the information.

parameters.name: device_count
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that specifies the number of RAWINPUTDEVICE structures in the array. On return, this variable will contain the number of devices registered.

parameters.name: device_size
parameters.description: Size of the RAWINPUTDEVICE structure, in bytes.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of devices registered. If the function fails, it returns ~0u.
